provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Names the means, instrument or material an action is carried out with, で with もって added to weight the means itself: 数字でもって裏付ける, 竹と紙でもって作る, often set against a means expected instead (言葉ではなく行動でもって). Two sibling entries take the other readings: the quality the actor brings (経験でもって) and the criterion a decision is reckoned by (多数決でもって). The written variants 以て and 以って are the stiffest.

examples.ruby: 主将[しゅしょう]は言葉[ことば]ではなく行動[こうどう]でもって皆[みな]を引[ひ]っ張[ぱ]った。
examples.english: The captain led the rest of us not with words but with what he actually did.

examples.ruby: 祖父[そふ]は竹[たけ]と紙[かみ]でもって立派[りっぱ]な凧[たこ]を作[つく]った。
examples.english: My grandfather made a magnificent kite out of nothing but bamboo and paper.

examples.ruby: その結論[けつろん]は詳[くわ]しい数字[すうじ]でもって裏付[うらづ]けられている。
examples.english: That conclusion is backed up by detailed figures, no less.

glosses: in the space of (an instant, a night)
all at once; at a single stroke
patterns.usage_note: Names the whole span something took, a noun of very short or compressed time plus にして: 一瞬にして, 一夜にして, 一代にして, with the sense that so much happened in so little. Two sibling senses take the other readings of this form: framing a circumstance, 幸いにして, 今にして思えば, and emphasis on an age or an attempt, 五十にして, 三度目にして. Narration and news writing; ordinary speech says 一瞬で or 一晩で.

examples.ruby: 火[ひ]の手[て]は一瞬[いっしゅん]にして倉庫[そうこ]全体[ぜんたい]を包[つつ]んだ。
examples.english: In an instant the flames had engulfed the entire warehouse.

examples.ruby: 無名[むめい]の写真[しゃしん]が一夜[いちや]にして世界中[せかいじゅう]に広[ひろ]まった。
examples.english: Overnight, a photograph nobody had heard of was all over the world.

examples.ruby: 祖父[そふ]は一代[いちだい]にして小[ちい]さな工場[こうじょう]を築[きず]いた。
examples.english: My grandfather built that little factory from nothing in a single generation.

glosses: with; by means of (a tool or method)
patterns.usage_note: Attaches to a noun naming the means, material or cause an event comes about through: 筆で書く, 布で作る, メールで送る, バスで通う, 大きな声で呼ぶ, 風邪で休む. Sibling で entries: place of an action (カフェで勉強する), price or standard (半額で), group as doer (会社で), copula linking form (休みで), te-form joint (呼んで). Cause で takes a noun; a whole clause of reason is carried by the te-form (重くて持てない).

examples.ruby: 余[あま]った布[ぬの]で子供[こども]用[よう]の小[ちい]さな袋[ふくろ]を作[つく]った。
examples.english: I made a little bag for the kids out of some leftover fabric.

examples.ruby: この字[じ]は細[ほそ]い筆[ふで]で書[か]いたほうがきれいだ。
examples.english: This character comes out better written with a fine brush.

examples.ruby: 風邪[かぜ]で三日[みっか]も学校[がっこう]を休[やす]みました。
examples.english: A cold kept me out of school for three whole days.
